input_policy: Unchanged frozen human-written prompts and data; no prior YAML or generated code copied
solver_policy: Dataset-only observed time-scale selection: ratio >=100 or inconclusive data selects Kvaerno5, otherwise Tsit5. No probe-triggered switching. Unchanged dynamic max_steps, state-scaled tolerances and parallel forward-accuracy checks.
notes: Prior initial_time setup retained for Schwen/Borghans. Missing-spec folders remain blocked. No full fits. Hardware and timing captured in manifest/model metadata.
reason: Full fresh batch requested, Beer first then remaining cases
max_steps_policy: Initial budget: largest per-experiment 30*T/tau_fast, rounded up to 1000, minimum 1000 and cap 50000. Inconclusive time scales retain configured 10000. Existing sampled recovery and tolerance validation unchanged.
accuracy_recovery_policy: Structured accuracy step-limit failures trigger bounded doubling of max_steps up to 50000, with unchanged solver/reference tolerances; existing total recovery deadline applies. Other accuracy failures do not trigger step escalation.
coverage_policy: Ten successful parameter samples independent of total sample count; no fraction-based stagnation stop
sampling_policy: One fixed sample set: min(128,max(32,16*d)), including estimated initial-condition axes; reused across every step-budget trial; ten successful samples required.
